comment.body: Thanks for the0xD1 bugcheck details and attached report. PowerToys.Peek being the active process does not identify the driver that corrupted memory. Could you share the faulting driver/module and stack from !analyze -v on the existing Windows minidump, with personal paths removed? That determines whether this should be investigated as a driver/VM issue or a reproducible interaction with Peek; please use the existing fault evidence rather than collecting unrelated application diagnostics.
